neighbours.label: the main verb after an organization's name in a mission or 'about us' statement (X creates value, inspires people)
fire: About us: Greenfield Partners helps families build lasting financial security.
The Ocean Trust protects marine habitats through research and education.
Northwind Labs builds software that helps hospitals run more smoothly.
Our foundation empowers young women to pursue careers in science.
Founded in 1990, Harbor Health provides affordable care to rural communities.
Brightline Energy delivers clean power to homes across the region.
The Literacy Project equips teachers with tools to help struggling readers.
At Copperleaf we connect local farmers with restaurants in the city.
quiet: Yesterday Greenfield Partners announced that its office would move in March.
The Ocean Trust was mentioned briefly in a newspaper article last week.
Last year Northwind Labs moved into a larger building downtown.
The meeting of our foundation was postponed because of the storm.
Founded in 1990, Harbor Health has its headquarters on Main Street.
Brightline Energy was sold to a larger company in 2019.
The Literacy Project held its annual dinner at a hotel on Friday.
At Copperleaf the parking lot was repaved over the summer.

notes: Card: ' creates', ' inspires', ' designs', ' power', ' works' right after a company/foundation subject in self-descriptions. Near misses keep the organization subject but use a plain news-event verb.
